notes.title: Weekly Challenges Are Here & We're Celebrating 1 Year!
notes.content:
Dear coffee lovers,

We can hardly believe it’s been a whole [b]year since we first opened the doors of our little Coffee Caravan[/b]. What started as a tiny idea has grown into a cozy corner of joy thanks to all of you — your kind words, thoughtful feedback, and the love you’ve shown mean the world to us.

To celebrate this special milestone, we’ve prepared a warm little update (version 1.4) we hope you’ll enjoy:

[h2]Weekly Challenges & Leaderboards[/h2]
A new way to play — and a little friendly competition!
Every week, you’ll find a new challenge waiting for you, featuring a unique recipe and layout. The goal? Finish it as fast as you can and see how you rank on the new leaderboard!

[list]
[*] A fresh challenge every week
[*] A different recipe each time
[*] Compete for the fastest time
[*] Compare and celebrate with the community
[/list]

Whether you’re going for the top spot or just enjoying a new way to play, we hope these weekly challenges bring a little spark of excitement to your cozy routine.

[h3]Also in this update:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Small improvements to bug reporting (so it's easier to let us know if something goes wrong)
[*] Better day length calculation for a more natural rhythm
[*] And of course, some gentle bug fixes to keep things running smoothly
[/list]

We’re so grateful to have shared this first year with you. Thank you for playing, for sharing your stories, and for making Coffee Caravan such a kind and wholesome place. Here’s to many more cozy moments together. ☕💕

With warm mugs and warm hearts,
Ondra & Alenka

notes.title: Coffee Caravan 1.3.2: Twitch & Crowd Control Fun for Streamers!
notes.content:
Hello, Coffee Caravan baristas!
We've brewed up a cozy little update that’s sure to delight our streamer friends and their lovely communities.

[list]
[*] [b]Twitch Integration[/b]
Now your viewers can join the fun! With Twitch chat, they can sprinkle a little chaos (or kindness!) into your caravan with interactive effects and playful graphical surprises. Whether it's helping you keep the coffee flowing or testing your multitasking skills, it’s all in good fun!

[*] [b]Crowd Control Integration[/b]
We’ve teamed up with Crowd Control to make your streams even more interactive. Viewers can support their favorite barista by purchasing effects that spice up the gameplay!

[*] [b]13 Unique Effects[/b]
From gentle nudges to delightful surprises, there are 13 ways for your viewers to leave their mark on your adventure. Let’s see how creative (and kind!) your community can get!

[*] [b]Bug Fixes & Improvements[/b]
We’ve smoothed out some rough edges to keep your caravan running smoothly. Thanks for all your feedback—it helps us make the game even cozier.
[/list]

It’s time to let your community jump into the Coffee Caravan fun! We can’t wait to see the streams, hear the laughs, and share in the joy. As always, thank you for being part of this wonderful journey 💕

Happy brewing,
Ondrej & Alena ☕

notes.title: Coffee Caravan 1.3.1: Traditional Chinese, Bugfixes, and More!
notes.content:
Hello, friends of the caravan!

We’re delighted to share the latest update for Coffee Caravan, brewed with care to make your experience even more enjoyable:

[list]
[*] Traditional Chinese Translation: The game is now welcoming even more players from around the world. We’re so excited to share our cozy caravan with a wider community.
[*] UI Improvements: We’ve added a little extra polish to make your caravan management as pleasant as sipping a perfectly brewed cup of tea.

notes.title: Ice Cream World Update Out Now: New Recipes, Customers, Features & More!
notes.content:
Hello, Coffee Caravan players!

The long-awaited [b]Ice Cream World Update has officially arrived[/b] a few days ago! 
We’re thrilled to see such a warm reception already and can’t wait for you to dive in and explore all the new flavors, visuals, and features we’ve added. Get ready for a cooler-than-ever experience in your caravan journey!

[h3]Key Features:[/h3]
[list]
[*] New Ice Cream Recipes – Delight your customers with fresh, unique frozen treats!
[*] New Appliance Sets for Ice Cream World – Specialized tools for serving ice cream efficiently.
[*] Ice Cream Stand – A new way to serve customers, bringing a twist to your operations!
[*] Colorful and Playful Graphics – A vibrant new environment to match the fun of the Ice Cream World.
[*] New Customers – Meet the Child and Tourist in Ice Cream World, and the Bamboo Farmer in Tea World!
[*] Panel with Shortcuts – Quickly move equipment between your warehouse and caravan.
[*] Translations – Now available in Korean and Russian!
[*] More Options in Character Customization – New blue hair color and accessory slots for items like mustaches and earrings.
[/list]

[h3]Other Changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Three new achievements
[*] Three new music tracks
[*] Order hints above customers' heads
[*] UI to show earnings from finished orders
[*] Improved calculation of decoration effects
[*] Practice mode and Appliance move shortcuts in the pause menu
[*] Improved caravan layout saving
[*] Anti-stuck check when adding new accessories
[*] A lot of small changes and bug fixes
[/list]

We hope you enjoy everything that’s been added in this update, and we’re excited to hear your feedback! Be sure to let us know what you think of the new Ice Cream World and all its frosty treats.

Thanks for your continued support – it means the world to us!

notes.title: Ice Cream World Update – Coming November 8th!
notes.content:
Hey, lovely Caravaners!

The wait is almost over! We’re thrilled to announce that the Ice Cream World update is arriving on [b]November 8th[/b]! Mark your calendars, because this frosty, fun-packed update is going to keep things cool and cozy in Coffee Caravan. 

And to celebrate, [b]Coffee Caravan will be on sale for -25%[/b] (starting November 8th at 10AM PT)! Don’t miss out on this sweet deal!

Here’s what you can expect when the update goes live:

[b]A Whole New World – Ice Cream World![/b]

[list]
[*] A refreshing new world with its own delicious ice cream recipes!
[*] Gorgeous new graphics and decor inspired by the ice cream theme. Your caravan is about to get a frosty makeover!
[*] New customers with sweet tooths are rolling in—better keep those ice cream machines running smoothly!
[/list]

[b]New Features & Improvements[/b]

[list]
[*] Shortcuts to rearrange your caravan layout quickly! Move items in bulk with ease—no more running around piece by piece!
[*] Reworked decoration system—now, the decor you choose has an even bigger impact on your café’s vibe!
[*] Two new languages added: Korean and Russian! We’re welcoming even more players to our cozy coffee family!
[/list]

[b]Improvements & Bug Fixes[/b]

[list]
[*] Several quality-of-life improvements to make running your café smoother and cozier!
[*] A few bugs have been squashed under our coffee mugs for good measure!
[/list]

So, cozy up, get ready for the ultimate chill café experience, and prepare for November 8th when the Ice Cream World update drops! Your caravan will never be the same!

Stay frosty,
Ondra & Alena
Broccoli Games

notes.title: macOS release
notes.content:
It's here! You can now play Coffee Caravan on your [b]macOS devices[/b]!
It took longer than we thought, but we hope you'll enjoy the game on another platform.

The release (1.2.0) includes not only the macOS version, but also some other improvements and fixes to the game that you've been asking for.
[b]What's New:[/b]
- macOS Release
- Added the ability to swap items placed on customer tables with what you're holding in your hand
- Added missing icons for some tea recipes
- Deleting a saved game with the gamepad now requires confirmation to prevent accidental deletion.
- Optimized and fixed UI to avoid breaking the layout
- Optimized some 3D models
- Fixed several translation issues in German, French, Chinese
- Zero Customer Scenario Achievement now unlocks even if map reset is turned off

Thank you for your patience, for reporting any issues, and for playing the game!
Please share this update with all your friends with Apple devices.

We have many more plans in the works, so look forward to more news!
Ondra & Alenka
Broccoli Games

notes.title: Update 1.1 - COZY and HARD difficulty
notes.content:
We are part of the [b]Cozy & Family Friendly Games Celebration 2024[/b] and we are releasing [b]Update 1.1[/b] for this event.

A lot of players wanted to enjoy brewing coffee and tea in a relaxed atmosphere. Maybe that's why they were surprised to learn that Coffee Caravan could be a bit of a challenge.
We listened to all the feedback and decided to add a difficulty option to the game. So now you can choose whether you want to play with COZY, NORMAL or HARD difficulty. You can also turn off the option that if the customer's patience runs out, your journey through the map will end and you will have to start all over again.
We hope you enjoy these options.
You can even change the difficulty level of existing saved games. 

What's new in the update:
- Difficulty selection - [b]COZY, NORMAL, HARD[/b]
- Option to disable the restart of the map progress when the customer's patience runs out
- Option to set the length of button hold (in accessibility settings)
- Option to map multi-function buttons on the mouse
Fixed:
- Improved German and Italian localization
- Fixed several bugs and issues in the UI

Thank you very much for your feedback and ideas!
We will definitely continue to work on the game and you help us a lot!
Ondra & Alenka

notes.title: Bugfix 1.0.1
notes.content:
Thank you all so much for the great bug reports and feedback! We are now releasing the first build with the most critical bugs fixed. There are no new features in this update, but we already have a long list of things we want to add.

List of changes in 1.0.1:
- Fixed disappearing and poorly scaling map
- Fixed a bug that caused an infinite number of Pour Over uses
- Fixed tutorial for Lime Bubble Tea
- Improved tutorial for Cappuccino
- Fixed minor bugs in Chinese localization
- Improved closing and display of the Pause window when another window was open
- Slightly modified tutorial UI
- Improved treasure initialization to avoid disabling gamepad control
- Added display of remapped keys in the tutorial and correct display of PlayStation gamepad buttons

Thank you!
Ondra & Alenka

notes.title: Demo Update 0.1.5
notes.content:
Thank you for all the feedback we received on the demo. We are also glad that you like the game and have many ideas for expansions and improvements.

[b]Based on the feedback, we have decided to make a few changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Keyboard Controls[/b] - The Space key is now used for pick/drop instead of the Shift key. Many players have complained that the Shift/Ctrl keys are too close together and it's not a standard layout. In the full version of the game, it will be possible to remap the control scheme.
[*] [b]Game Difficulty[/b] - Many did not feel enough of a challenge and increase in difficulty in the demo. We have adjusted the values to make the difficulty more balanced.
[/list]

We hope you will enjoy the changes.

Ondra&Alenka
Broccoli Games
